from pathlib import Path
import json,os,time,subprocess
s=Path('/home/claude/.scratch/eka-sky-performance');r=Path('/home/claude/code/EKA2L1-sky-performance')
for index,route,assets,end in [(0,'combat',s/'assets',48000000),(3,'standard',Path('/home/claude/.scratch/eka-benchmark/assets'),39000000)]:
 meta=json.loads((s/f'dynamic-v30-screen-{index:02d}-{route}-control-command.json').read_text())
 env={k:v for k,v in os.environ.items()if not k.startswith('EKA2L1_')};env.update(meta['env'])
 args=['node','profile.ts',str(assets),str(s/f'v30-control-profile-{route}'),'1','1',str(end)]
 (s/f'v30-control-profile-{route}-command.json').write_text(json.dumps({'args':args,'env':meta['env'],'purpose':'CPU sampling after serial timing; detailed counters and guest census disabled. Not speed evidence.'},indent=2))
 with(s/f'v30-control-profile-{route}.log').open('w')as f:subprocess.run(args,cwd=r/'src/tests/wasm',env=env,stdout=f,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,timeout=1800,check=True)

scripts.analyze_cpu_control_v30.py:
from pathlib import Path
import json,collections,re
s=Path('/home/claude/.scratch/eka-sky-performance');out=[]
for route in ('combat','standard'):
 folder=s/f'v30-control-profile-{route}';report=json.loads((folder/'report.json').read_text())
 assert report['sampling'] and not report['measurement']['detailed'] and not report['guest_profile_stride'] and report['synchronous_compilation']==0
 for p in sorted(folder.glob('*.cpuprofile')):
  q=json.loads(p.read_text());nodes={x['id']:x for x in q['nodes']};parents={c:x['id'] for x in q['nodes']for c in x.get('children',[])};self_time=collections.Counter();inclusive=collections.Counter();total=0
  for ident,delta in zip(q.get('samples',[]),q.get('timeDeltas',[])):
   seconds=delta/1e6;total+=seconds;self_time[nodes[ident]['callFrame']['functionName']]+=seconds
   ancestors=set();seen=set()
   while ident in nodes and ident not in seen:
    seen.add(ident);ancestors.add(nodes[ident]['callFrame']['functionName']);ident=parents.get(ident)
   for name in ancestors:inclusive[name]+=seconds
  generated=sum(v for k,v in self_time.items()if re.match(r'^(?:f_\d+|r_\d+_pc_\d+)$',k))
  loop=sum(v for k,v in self_time.items()if 'InterpreterMainLoop(' in k)
  loop_inclusive=sum(v for k,v in inclusive.items()if 'InterpreterMainLoop(' in k)
  out.append({'route':route,'file':str(p),'sample_weighted_span_seconds':total,'generated_self_seconds':generated,'outer_execution_loop_self_seconds':loop,'outer_execution_loop_inclusive_seconds':loop_inclusive,'generated_self_percent':100*generated/total if total else 0,'outer_execution_loop_self_percent':100*loop/total if total else 0,'top_self':[{'name':k,'seconds':v,'percent':100*v/total}for k,v in self_time.most_common(25)],'note':'CPU sampling with normal browser flags and detailed counters disabled. Weighted sample spans are diagnostics, not unpaced benchmark results. InterpreterMainLoop contains the inlined compiled runner; the symbol alone does not identify interpreter fallback.'})
(s/'v30-control-cpu-profile-analysis.json').write_text(json.dumps(out,indent=2))
for x in out:
 if x['outer_execution_loop_inclusive_seconds']>1:print(x['route'],x['file'],x['generated_self_percent'],x['outer_execution_loop_self_percent'],x['top_self'][:6])
